collection.description: A shell collector has promised more rare shells than the shoreline can supply.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A shell collector promises more rare shells than the shoreline can supply and fears losing an important customer.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The customer agrees to wait or choose another design.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The beach is stripped of shells and children complain they can no longer find any.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A new mosaic craft grows from the shortage.
